messages:
sam: quick heads-up while bringing up northstar-70b-int8v1. Hit a repeatable semantic divergence when prompt crosses ~72k tokens. suspect fencepost / kv-index modulus bug in int8 path.

violet: smallest repro? kernel/runtime info?

sam: super tiny repro:
```python
prompt = 'PARAGRAPH\n' + ('Z'*1500 + '\n')*48  # ~72k tokens
resp = client.generate(model='northstar-70b-int8v1', prompt=prompt, max_tokens=8)
print(resp.text[-60:])
```
fp16 baseline returns "...PARAGRAPH COMPLETE OK"; int8 shows "...PARAGRAPH COMPLET?" starting at token 71984.

omar: logs around the event? kv read/idx lines?

sam: pasted relevant lines: 
```nKVCACHE: put_idx=71984 shard=0
KVCACHE: read_idx=71984 -> mapped_idx=448
KVCACHE: fencepost=72000
```
mapped_idx goes small near fencepost.

violet: can you dump a few entries near the mapped idx? hex please.

sam: kv-dump snippet (trimmed):
```n0x0011f400: ff ff 7f 00 00 00 00 00 88 00 00 00 aa bb cc dd
0x0011f410: 00 00 80 00 ff ff ff ff 20 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
```
looks like sign flip bytes around the boundary.

omar: plausible root cause: modulus with window_size uses signed remainder or int-truncation when combining pos+offset. In int8 packing we reuse a 32-bit signed accumulator in a hot path; when pos ~ window_size it overflows to small positive number.

violet: plan: 1) add assert in debug build that mapped_idx < window_size, 2) simple hotfix clamp: mapped_idx = ((mapped_idx % window_size) + window_size) % window_size, 3) unit test sweep for window sizes [65536, 72000, 131072] and offsets around fenceposts +/- [0..512], 4) perf compare.

sam: perf micro: baseline int8 p95 token latency 6.8ms; clamp hotfix p95 6.85ms (+0.7%). 64-bit wide fix cost ~4-6% so not ideal for hotfix.

ci-bot: CI started for PR 11002 by sam: https://git.redwood/infra/11002

violet: once CI green we should canary to 2 dedicated nodes (int8 + fp16) and run a long-run (10k tokens) to verify non-regression. Also add onboarding step: "fencepost kv wrap check".

omar: add a quick fuzzer that targets boundary windows and random rope_scale values so we catch similar issues across quant variants. I'll open a tech-debt ticket to migrate index math to unsigned 64-bit in the qkernel.

sam: PR posted with repro, dumps, unit, and perf numbers. Will update with canary link. Thanks! :thumbsup:
